summary.content:
Today's selection covers 70 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 47 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic C.E.O. Dario Amodei Calls for A.I. Slowdown
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers exploit Tencent app flaw to deploy GrayRabbit malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 20 articles published in the last 24 hours
